title: An Efficient Second-Order-in-Time Penalty-Projection Ensemble Eddy Viscosity Method for Parameterized Navier-Stokes Flows
summary: We propose a novel, robust, and second-order-accurate parameterized penalty-projection ensemble algorithm for incompressible Navier--Stokes flow problems. The resulting linearized algorithm, based on the second-order Backward Differentiation Formula (BDF-2), is computationally efficient because it shares the same coefficient matrix across all realizations for each subproblem at every time step. To enhance robustness in convection-dominated flows, the scheme incorporates Ensemble Eddy Viscosity (EEV) regularization.
